config.signature: 14 current-record available prefix means; missing imputed reference-hour median only; reference-only standardization per hour
config.reference: samefarm samepass strictly earlier public training day; outer/inner validation +/-1 purged
config.anchor: mean of 3 nearest signature reference days, stable day tie-break
config.gate: cost-sensitive LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=3000 tol=1e-8; probability>=.5
config.cost: abs(SSE_base-SSE_anchor), normalized to mean1 on nonzero eligible inner rows
config.ridge: Ridge alpha=100 target hourly residual, .2*clip(predicted residual,-.3,.3)
config.features: current baseline, prefix baseline, anchor, anchor-minus-prefix, d1,d2,top3label std, log1p(n), 14 prefix means, hour/23
config.output: post-final correction plus baseline, train-bounds clip; pass1/noanchors unchanged
config.inner: existing matched heldout b subset, base trained only a; anchor references a; meta preprocessing fit eligible b only
config.empty_training: do not fit; keep baseline unchanged
